blurb: Angelica Run Farm offers boarding, mini leasing with instruction, and non-competitive equine programs. The Pony Pool program is a mini-lease for riders aged 5 and up to lease a horse for weekly lessons. The Advanced Rider Program is a leasing program for proficient riders to ride independently twice per week.
